points.point: The Vault's signal integrity capability list is a high-speed PCB/PCBA flow: IL / Xtalk / eye diagram, TDR impedance, Stackup Planner, TL Calculator — not a wireless-application list.
points.label: contradicted

points.point: Signal Integrity is positioned in the Digital / high-speed digital test context, with RF as a separate target category, so the Vault does not frame SI as a wireless-communication capability area.
points.label: contradicted
